purpose: Test whether Pico 2020/2021/2022/2024 dated field observations revisit the same source-defined physical sites, independently of taxon observations. Not an occupancy or local persistence endpoint.

authority.author_dates: M/D/YYYY, validated against year+month+day all 2801 records

event_only_archive_table: Event core index=0; NEVER open any Occurrence distribution table or taxon identifiers
site_primary: Exact non-empty original locationID, if available, with all its original georeferences varying by at most 0.01 degree in latitude and longitude. Do NOT use eventID or locality as a site ID.

site_secondary_sensitivity.exact_gps_5_decimals: Only finite WGS84 lat/lon records, both to 5 decimals (~1 meter precision); distinct years
site_secondary_sensitivity.rounded_gps_4_decimals: Independent sensitivity (~11 m latitude), NOT a validated permanent plot
site_secondary_sensitivity.rounded_gps_3_decimals: Coarse independent sensitivity (~111 m latitude), no original fixed-site inference

temporal_rules.primary_repeated_site: Same author locationID / exact source site, 2 or more distinct calendar years with at least one dated event in each
temporal_rules.strict_repeated_sampling: Same site, each of at least two distinct years contains at least 2 distinct calendar dates (not merely two eventID values from a day)
temporal_rules.method_comparability: Sampling protocol missing or varying at site/year: report uncertainty; never claim standardized zero-detection denominator
temporal_rules.coordinate_unavailable: UNKNOWN spatial site identity, not zero truly repeated physical sites

stop_decision: If author source lacks a reliable site key, repeated calendar-year detected plant taxa remain island-year positives only; do not substitute coarse GPS neighborhoods as standardized repeat-survey/true absence.
